item.description:
0.2.2

  • The dictionary learns from your edits automatically: fix a term right where the text was inserted, and it becomes a replacement. Only the field the app typed into is re-read, briefly; toggle in Settings.
  • Keyboard shortcuts sharing your dictation modifier no longer trigger phantom recordings or silent hands-free mode.

0.2.1

  • Keyboard shortcuts that share your dictation modifier no longer start phantom recordings, and two shortcuts in a row no longer enable hands-free mode silently.
  • Live transcription preview while you speak, with a microphone-level indicator.
  • Recognition language control: Automatic plus 29 languages; interface fully in English.
